mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHAT_MESSAGES (CHAT_MESSAGE_ID, INSTITUTION_ID, ROLE, CONTENT, CREATED_AT, AUTHOR) VALUES (#{chatMessageId}, #{institutionId}, #{role}, #{content,jdbcType=CLOB}, #{createdAt}, #{author,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: SELECT CHAT_MESSAGE_ID, INSTITUTION_ID, ROLE, CONTENT, CREATED_AT, AUTHOR FROM CHAT_MESSAGES WHERE INSTITUTION_ID = #{institutionId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT
